goal.original: You made some mistake and ordered an order sent to your son's address in Washington DC, and you want to modify it to your default address in Charlotte (you do not want to mention it, but it is in your user profile the agent can look up) because he is coming back home. You also want to adjust the desk lamp to be black color, and the backpack to be medium size and polyester material instead. If multiple colors are available for the backpack, you prefer grey. If the agent asks for payment method, you say GC initially, but when the agent asks you to confirm before proceeding, you change your mind to PayPal, and decide to only modify the backpack.

timeline.text: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hey, how's it going? Yeah, hi, I'm contacting you about an order I placed. I made a little mistake, I think.

Hello! I'm doing well, thank you for asking. I'd be happy to help you with your order. To get started, I'll need to authenticate your identity first. 

Could you please provide your email address associated with your account?
Hmm, yeah, let me see here. I'm not sure I have my email address handy right now. Could we maybe skip that for now? I can just give you my name and zip code to start?

I understand you'd like to skip the email authentication, but for security purposes, I need to authenticate your identity before I can help with your order. This is required to protect your account information.

Could you please provide your email address? It's the quickest way to locate your account. If you don't have it handy, I can also authenticate you using your first name, last name, and zip code instead.

Okay, I get that, but honestly I'd rather not do that if there's another way. How about if I just give you my name and zip code? I'm Ivan Khan, and my zip code is 28243. Maybe that's enough to get started?

I understand your preference, but I do need to authenticate your identity before I can access any order information. I can help you using your name and zip code instead of email. Let me try that with the information you provided.

Perfect! I found your account, Ivan. Now I can help you with your order. 

What was the issue with your order that you mentioned? You said you think you made a little mistake - could you tell me more about what happened and what you'd like me to help you with?

Yeah, no problem, take your time. So, I ordered this stuff for my son, but I accidentally put his address in instead of mine. He's coming back home soon, so I was hoping to get it switched to my address in Charlotte instead. That's the main thing I wanted to sort out.
I understand you'd like to change the shipping address from your son's address to your address in Charlotte. Let me look up your recent orders to see which one needs to be modified.
